records.text: The entire scene looks like it's happening in like a crusty Motel 8 on the side of a highway. It's giving Breaking Bad. And when I envision how the picture, that moment, came together, it just disturbs me a little bit. I just, I just imagine happy-go-lucky toddler being put under a hat, her mom saying sweet things between takes as she's trying to get the sad face right, trying to nail the sad face and be like, 'It's okay, baby,' and then like—
records.speaker: Candace Owens
